jobs.description:
Für den Standort Brüssel suchen wir:

Solution Architect (m/w/d)

Your tasks:

- Analysis of functional and technical requirements and derivation of suitable solution architectures
- Creation of architecture concepts, technical designs, and standards
- Advising internal stakeholders on technologies, architecture principles, and best practices
- Evaluation and selection of suitable technologies, platforms, and system components
- Ensuring the technical quality, scalability, security, and maintainability of the solution
- Supporting the entire software life cycle – from planning and implementation to operation
- Coordinating and liaising with development teams, project managers, and external partners
- Conducting architecture reviews and risk analyses
- Documenting architecture decisions and relevant technical artifacts
- Assisting with the preparation of cost estimates and project plans

Your qualifications:

- Degree in computer science, business informatics, or comparable qualification
- Several years of professional experience in software development or system architecture
- In-depth knowledge of modern IT architectures (e.g., cloud, microservices, API design, integration)
- Understanding of common technologies and frameworks depending on the area of application
- Experience with architecture methods and standards (e.g., TOGAF, UML, C4 model)
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in an understandable way
- Structured, analytical mindset and high quality awareness
- Fluent German and English skills
- Willingness to travel approx. 50% of the time

We offer:

- Career opportunities
- Individually tailored training program
- Fair, trusting working environment
- Regular networking events
- Benefits from our partners in the areas of health, insurance, and shopping
- Company pension plan

The requirements for employees are diverse. So are our job offers. Guldberg stands for “perfect matching” and specializes in the automotive, rail vehicle technology, plant engineering, telecommunications, banking, and insurance industries, offering you exciting opportunities in the fields of mechanical engineering, electronics, and information technology. For us, our employees always come first. In addition to attractive pay, we offer you long-term career prospects. Your career opportunities are complemented by a customized training program, ranging from personal development to professional qualifications. We are also committed to creating a fair, trusting, and personal working environment. In addition to regular networking events, we offer you benefits with our partners in the areas of fitness, health, insurance, and shopping.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 3-5 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist - Drive digital transformation in a cloud environment
jobs.description:
Ready to use your SAP expertise in a project that makes a real impact? This is your opportunity to play a key role in a major digital transformation within an international organization that is investing heavily in innovation, technology, and process optimization.

For a leading company active in the housing and real estate sector, we are looking for a temporary reinforcement to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You will join a forward-thinking environment where your contribution will directly influence the success of an important digitalization project.
Your responsibilities
As an S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist, you will help ensure a smooth and successful implementation process by:

• Supporting the rollout of SAP S/4HANA Cloud across the organization
• Assisting in the optimization and digitalization of business processes
• Providing support to end users and answering system-related questions
• Executing test scenarios and documenting findings
• Analyzing workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners
• Creating and maintaining process documentation and user guidelines
• Contributing to a seamless transition toward the new ERP environment
In short, this is a varied position where you can make a tangible contribution to a high-impact transformation project.

We are seeking a proactive professional who can quickly adapt to a dynamic project environment and enjoys improving processes.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential
• Familiarity with cloud-based ERP systems
• Fluent communication skills in English
• Previous experience in ERP implementation, digital transformation, or system migration projects
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues
• An understanding of business processes in sales, operations, or administration is a plus
You do not need to know everything already, but a solid SAP foundation and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in this role.

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

Are you looking to kickstart your career in construction? Join us as a General Construction Worker where every day is a new opportunity to make a tangible impact. You'll be working on varied projects, gaining hands-on experience in demolition, masonry, insulation, and more. 

Your typical day will be dynamic and rewarding. You'll assist skilled workers, ensure site safety, and help maintain project flow. Your contribution is critical in creating structures that stand strong and look impressive. 

Ready to put your skills to the test and grow with us? Apply today and be part of a team that values your effort and dedication.

• Experience in construction (minimum one year)

• Communicative English skills

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow in construction

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation (a plus)

• VCA certificate

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You are a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium
• Have a valid Belgian address
• Have legal permission to work in Belgium
Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

jobs.occupation: Production Operator - Immediate Start in a Growing Coatings Company
jobs.description:
Your Role

As a Production Operator Coatings, you are hands-on in the entire coatings production process. You ensure every batch is produced accurately and safely, from raw material to finished product.

What You Will Do

• Prepare raw materials and equipment

• Accurately weigh and add ingredients following recipes

• Operate and monitor mixing installations

• Closely follow mixing parameters (temperature, timing, method)

• Take samples and assist with quality controls

• Register production and quality data accurately

• Fill finished coatings into packaging and check weights

• Label and palletize finished products

• Keep machines and workstations clean and safe

• Report issues or deviations promptly

• Support your colleagues and be flexible within production

A Typical Day

You start the day by preparing materials and checking your workstation. Throughout the day, you follow set procedures for mixing and quality control, keep accurate records, and communicate any issues to your team leader. You end your shift with a tidy workplace and clear handover for the next day.

Ready to grow with us?

If you are looking for a varied, responsible role in production and want to be part of an ambitious team, we encourage you to apply!

• Minimum a few years of experience in a production environment (mixing, weighing, quality control)

• Experience with paint, coatings, chemical products, or mixing is a strong advantage

• Physically able to regularly lift weights up to 25kg

• B driving license required; willing to occasionally drive to Brussels

• Forklift experience for handling heavy pallets

• Very good command of English; understanding of Dutch is an asset

• Flexible, all-round team player

• Motivated for a long-term collaboration

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks
